identity_firewall.brand_and_proper_noun_masking: best-effort additional masking on top of issuer/ticker masking

allowed: infer multi-step causal chain from supplied evidence
decide whether different wording belongs to the same upstream economic causal chain
forbidden: use facts not present in the packet
llm_task.edge_rule: Every accepted company-driver edge must cite at least one contemporaneous evidence_id from the packet.

leakage_audit.ablation_rule: Removing cited causal evidence must materially reduce edge confidence or membership for the affected company.

interpretation: Identity-blinded, evidence-constrained, return-blind LLM adjudication. This controls access to future information but does not mathematically erase latent future knowledge in model weights.
historical_status: Methodology was designed after observing B4-v2 and B4-v3.1 historical results; therefore historical B4-v4 is a robustness experiment, not untouched out-of-sample evidence.
